source_ref.quote: Notes for Figure 6P-33—Typical Application 33 Stationary Lane Closure on a Divided Highway
Figure 6P-33. Stationary Lane Closure on a Divided Highway (TA-33)

This information also shall be used when work is being performed in the lane adjacent to the median on a divided highway. In this case, the LEFT LANE CLOSED signs and the corresponding Lane Ends signs shall be substituted.
When a side road intersects the highway within the TTC zone, additional TTC devices shall be placed as needed.

When paved shoulders having a width of 8 feet or more are closed, channelizing devices should be used to close the shoulder in advance of the merging taper to direct vehicular traffic to remain within the traveled way.
A truck-mounted attenuator may be used on the work vehicle and/or shadow vehicle.
Positive protection devices may be used per Section 6M.02.
Where conditions permit, restricting all vehicles, equipment, workers, and their activities to one side of the roadway might be advantageous.
An arrow board shall be used when a freeway lane is closed. When more than one freeway lane is closed, a separate arrow board shall be used for each closed lane.

source_ref.transcription: Figure 6P-33 has panel A (long-term and intermediate) and panel B (short-term), each showing the approach with the right lane closed. From the work outward: a W4-2R Lane Ends sign at dimension A from the upstream end of the shoulder taper, a W20-5R RIGHT LANE CLOSED XX MILE sign at B, and a W20-1 ROAD WORK XX MILE sign at C. Each sign is posted on both the right-hand and the left-hand side of the roadway. An arrow board stands in the closed lane at the start of the merging taper, which is dimensioned L; a 'Shoulder taper (see Note 3)' is upstream of it; 'Buffer space (optional)' lies between the merging taper and the work space. Panel A adds a 'Temporary white edge line'; panel B shows a 'Work vehicle' and a 'Truck-mounted attenuator (optional)'. A G20-2 END ROAD WORK sign labelled '(optional)' is downstream on both sides of the roadway.
Figure 6P-33, panels A and B: a dimension labelled '500 ft' runs from the downstream end of the closure to the G20-2 END ROAD WORK sign.
Figure 6P-33, panel A only: a dimension labelled '100 ft (optional)' runs along the downstream taper, from the downstream end of the work space to the end of the taper.

ta.title: Stationary Lane Closure on a Divided Highway

eligibility_condition.description: The work is within the traveled way (D-60 tree).
Multi-lane: two or more lanes in the direction of the closure (Sect. 6N.11 paras 02 and 03).
Road form, branch 1 of the one OR'd rule (D-60): a divided highway (figure title).
Road form, branch 2 (Sect. 6N.11 para 06): undivided four-lane road with the right-hand lane closed. Owner decision: stays a proposed interpretation; an undivided road routes to this SME question.
eligibility_condition.interpretation: PROPOSED, not owner-approved: divided_highway = false, lanes_per_direction = 2 and closed_lane_side = RIGHT (see R-6N11-TA33-UNDIVIDED-FOUR-LANE).
eligibility_condition.sme_question: Sect. 6N.11 para 06 allows Figure 6P-33 on 'undivided or divided four-lane roads' when the right-hand lane is closed. Does this undivided site qualify (two lanes each way, right lane closed)?

rule.text: Work in the lane next to the median: substitute LEFT LANE CLOSED signs and the corresponding Lane Ends signs.
A side road intersecting within the TTC zone gets additional TTC devices as needed.
Closed paved shoulders 8 ft or wider: close the shoulder with channelizing devices before the merging taper.
A truck-mounted attenuator may be used on the work vehicle and/or shadow vehicle.
Positive protection devices may be used (Sect. 6M.02).
Where conditions permit, keeping all vehicles, equipment, workers and activities on one side of the roadway might help.
An arrow board shall be used when a freeway lane is closed; one arrow board per closed freeway lane.
The figure dimensions '500 ft' from the downstream end of the closure to the G20-2 END ROAD WORK sign. Figure-only value; owner decision Q-A: stays SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
rule.sme_question: Figure 6P-33 shows '500 ft' from the end of the closure to the END ROAD WORK sign (render, page 925). Confirm the reading and whether the draft should use it.

rule.text: Panel A dimensions the downstream taper '100 ft (optional)'. Figure-only value; owner decision Q-A: stays SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
rule.sme_question: Figure 6P-33 panel A shows a downstream taper labelled '100 ft (optional)' (render, page 925). Confirm the reading and whether the draft should use it.
